disposition_reason: ICP-OES means (µg/mL) for cadmium, cobalt, chromium, lead, tin and copper in fresh tender coconut water by state (Table 4) and packaged coconut water by brand code (Table 5); arsenic and mercury reported in text.

study.design: Survey of pesticide residues and heavy metals in fresh and packaged tender coconut water
study.origin: Coconut-growing districts of Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India (fresh samples from farms)
study.market: Packaged samples from local markets and processing units in the three states
study.method: HNO3 hot-plate digestion of 25 mL; ICP-OES (Thermo iCAP 6500 Duo)
study.lod_text: LOD 0.0001-0.0056 µg/mL and LOQ 0.0003-0.0168 µg/mL across analytes (not given per analyte)
study.qa: Linearity R2 0.9994-1.0000, precision RSD 0.08-0.69%; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Methods state 161 fresh samples, but Table 4 accounts for 126 (42 per state).
Means appear to be computed over detected samples only ("n - number of samples detected"), so they overstate all-sample means.
Per-analyte LOD/LOQ values are not given.
Pesticide results are not metals and were not extracted.
Fresh samples were collected from farms (site_context ordinary); packaged samples from markets and processing units.
